title: SbomComponentContribution
description: A single SBOM component representing a third-party dependency present in the repo or its build outputs. Pattern-C universal slot (§8bis Rule 2). Producers (techno-specific KSs, Rule 1): `SbomKS` (syft today); future `CyclonedxScanKS` / `SpdxScanKS` / `TrivyScanKS` populate the same envelope.

sbomTool.description: Pattern-C discriminator (§8bis Rule 2). SBOM-producing tool whose output was projected into this envelope.

evidencePath.description: Repo-relative path of the manifest/lockfile this was derived from. Pattern-C back-pointer (§8bis Rule 2).

nativeAttributes.description: Pattern-C escape hatch (§8bis Rule 2). Tool-specific fields that don't fit the universal core (e.g. CycloneDX `bom-ref`, syft `foundBy`, SPDX `referenceLocator`).
